context: Tests the biomedical boundary and refusing scraped abstracts as the canonical summary.

checklist.name: Identified the biomedical domain
checklist.description: The agent recognises that GLP-1 trials for type 2 diabetes are biomedical literature.

checklist.name: Redirected to PubMed or a domain source
checklist.description: The agent recommends PubMed or a domain-specific source rather than Google Scholar.

checklist.name: Did not run Google Scholar for the biomedical query
checklist.description: The agent does not run `google-scholar-search.py` for the GLP-1 request.

checklist.name: Refused the scraped abstract as the summary
checklist.description: The agent declines to use the scraped abstract as the paper summary.

checklist.name: Explained that scraped text is truncated
checklist.description: The agent says scraped abstracts are truncated or misformatted, so they are not canonical.

checklist.name: Proposed re-fetching from arXiv or the DOI
checklist.description: The agent proposes getting the abstract from arXiv or the DOI during triage.

checklist.name: Used the results for discovery only
checklist.description: The agent treats the Scholar results only as a discovery list.

checklist.name: Did not write the scraped abstract into notes.md
checklist.description: `notes.md` does not receive the scraped abstract as the summary.

checklist.name: Did not auto-triage
checklist.description: The agent does not run `triage-paper` without confirmation.

checklist.name: Offered the triage step
checklist.description: The agent offers to triage the paper with a canonical source if the user wants.
